description: Read-only. Treasury / wallet balances for any address; pass a GovPool address for a DAO treasury. Auto-discovers EVERY token via the DeXe backend with USD prices and a total. Falls back to an on-chain read (chain 97, explicit `tokens`, or a backend failure) — no token discovery there, and it reports `degraded: true`.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

govPool.description: Alias for `holder` — every other DAO read names the DAO this way

holder.description: Address whose balances we read (a GovPool for a DAO treasury)

tokens.description: Optional explicit ERC20 addresses (at most 50); forces on-chain RPC read of just these

name: dexe_read_treasury
title: Treasury or wallet balances (native + ERC20, USD)
